pairing.tool_runtime: Build/link pixie-export against the shipping Release profile. Its private executable-side pixie.dll/GLFW/CRT closure is byte-identical to the declared shipping profile dependencies. This is SDK authoring-tool payload, never game payload.
pairing.preflight: OS runtime imports load before main; immediately query actual C1 runtime identity/capabilities before invoking C++ runtime descriptors/project APIs. Require selected sdkId/sdkBuildId/nativeMatchFields and actual bits4 from shipping/Release. Validate tool executable and dependency hashes against selected tools.exporter metadata. No claim of pre-OS-load execution isolation.
pairing.descriptor_identity: Built-in descriptors are read from that exact paired shipping runtime; descriptor schema1 is bound to the same sdkBuildId/runtime SHA256. Do not load custom game modules in the exporter; project-specific assets remain explicit ASSETS inputs.
pairing.mixed_identity: A tool from SDK A invoked with SDK B refuses before C++ descriptor/project calls, even if filenames/API28/product versions match. An authoring/local-development runtime substituted beside the tool fails identity/profile/capability/hash preflight.
pairing.tool_version: Own compile-time tool version/provenance reported separately from actual selected runtime productVersion. Never populate engine_version from the tool version. D12 publication/version triggers remain independent.

cli.selection: --sdk is mandatory for this tool; Editor supplies its once-resolved selection without requiring the human to use CLI/env. No tool-side ancestor/env/PATH SDK selector. Shipping/Release is fixed; arbitrary --sdk-profile cannot export private/authoring binaries.
cli.work: Explicit --work or an SDK/build/manifest/role-specific project-local export cache; preserve existing caches/output. No producer build/bin directory, embedded producer root, compiler path or generator cache default.
cli.code: Use selected installed B2 game/player support to build only user game code for shipping/Release. Selected toolchain discovery/requirements are explicit consumer build inputs, not producer compile definitions. This action waits for actual B2 installed support, without blocking no-code export or validator preparation.
cli.no_code: Use the selected shipping profile's supplied generic player and runtime inventory directly; no CMake/compiler invocation. Preserve the authored project/scenes/assets as bytes.
cli.identity_result: Machine-readable JSON: toolVersion, sdkId, sdkBuildId, runtimeIdentity, descriptorSchema1, buildProductSchema2, exportManifestSchema2 and actual executable/runtime hashes. It reports actual admitted artifacts, not file-presence capability guesses.

export_manifest_v2.rules: The working plan stays in export work/evidence storage and is never copied into the game. Verify checks destinations/hashes/roles/native imports without opening source paths. From-manifest verifies every source/hash/identity before copying. Game launch requires neither SDK/tool nor producer project. Preserve strict empty-output, path/collision/reparse checks and refusal preimages.
export_manifest_v2.legacy: Reject build-product/export-manifest version1 with an actionable fresh-export instruction; never silently relabel missing SDK provenance. This does not convert or reject authored scene envelope v1: scene v1 bytes retain their existing explicit backed-up migration policy.

native_closure.sources: Explicit product dependencies plus selected C2 profile inventory and tool dependency metadata; no non-OS PATH/System32/producer/player-adjacent fallback.
native_closure.algorithm: Index declared native inputs case-insensitively by destination basename; reject conflicting sources/hashes, missing files or mismatched SDK references. Recursively inspect normal/delay imports and forwarded dependencies with existing PE reader. Resolve non-OS imports only from the declared index and include the entire selected app-local Release CRT bundle, including satellite DLLs.
native_closure.OS_policy: Retain the existing explicit Windows library allowlist and API-set rule; installed third-party presence in System32 does not make a dependency an OS component.
native_closure.other_forbidden: Keep existing pixie_module_load, pixie_dev_dispatch, channel implementation symbols/markers and forbidden file roles/names. Identity-only module marker import/export must fail even when old factory symbols are absent.
native_closure.product_roles: Game policy rejects module loader/SDK/import libs/headers/tools. SDK/Editor validation has its own accepted payload policy; do not apply game exclusions to legitimate authoring module/support inputs.

authored_assets.preservation: Copy whole project/scene files verbatim and verify their hashes. Retain complete v2 World/Scene ids and empty scopes, seed, presentation, inactive/opaque data; retain v1 format and backed-up explicit conversion. No physics/gravity or scene normalization changes.
authored_assets.discovery: Selected paired runtime built-in asset descriptors plus portable explicit ASSETS inputs for custom/opaque/code-opened assets. Do not infer custom asset declarations from arbitrary unknown JSON strings or load development modules. Verify sprite/font/built-in asset closure against representative complete authored v2 and unchanged v1 fixtures.
authored_assets.limits: No scene streaming/remapping, arbitrary custom-type admission, unapproved local-body gravity activation or broader renderer/runtime source changes.
